watch.github-repo-advisories: checked daily against the upstream repository's published GitHub security advisories
watch.node-releases: the exactly pinned Node checked daily against its own line's security releases and end of life (nodejs.org index + release schedule) and the Node Security WG core advisories
watch.osv: exact version checked daily against OSV (scripts/security_watch.py)
watch.osv-package: all OSV advisories of the package fetched daily; affected ranges evaluated by the watch itself (OSV does not version-match this ecosystem)
